description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance metric for three different LLaMA model sizes—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct training conditions, as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis categorizes the models by size, while the vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, using a linear scale. Each model has four bars corresponding to the training conditions: a light blue bar with diagonal stripes for “no SFT”, a yellow bar with horizontal stripes for “+ SFT on D₀”, a light purple bar with diagonal stripes for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and a pink bar with diagonal stripes for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. For each model, the bars are arranged in a group, with the “no SFT” condition consistently showing the lowest performance, followed by the “+ SFT on D₀” condition, then “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and finally “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” which consistently achieves the highest score. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the model sizes. The chart does not show any visual emphasis such as bolding or shading for any specific bar.
